{{Top|leg}}
'''Crystalline memory plaques''' were information storage devices that were prevalent around the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Grand Sith War]], and were considered ancient by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Large numbers of the plaques were stored on [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]], containing a wealth of knowledge about the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]], a [[Historian/Legends|historian]] and [[Musician/Legends|musician]], rescued a large amount of plaques when she visited Exis Station in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="Firestorm">{{JournalCite|15|Firestorm (short story)}}</ref>
